children: Stocks of ethanol in the U.S. rose week-over-week, according to data from the EIA. They jumped 616,000 barrels for the week ended Oct. 16, to 24.56 million barrels. Analysts surveyed by Dow Jones this week had anticipated stocks to land anywhere from 23.7 million barrels to 23.9 million barrels. Average daily production also rose, climbing 23,000 barrels a day to 1.033 million barrels a day. Most-active corn futures on the CBOT are flat midday, at $4.62 a bushel. (kirk.maltais@wsj.com)
